description: Live map of the x402 pay-per-call market from the public Coinbase Bazaar: for 30 common intents (prices, weather, filings, dns, search, packages...), how many wallets paid the best route in the last 30 days, how many sellers compete, and the cheapest price. Use it to decide what is worth building or calling. Free.
name: demand_map
title: Where agents actually pay, by intent
